headword: {縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}

definitions.gloss: freely in all directions, unrestricted, without limitation
definitions.explanation: Moving or acting freely and without any constraint in every direction. Literally means 'vertically and horizontally without limit.' Used to describe someone or something that operates with complete freedom, versatility, and energy across a wide range.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦グラウンド→グラウンド：10813_guraundo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}った→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧。
examples.english: The player ran freely all over the field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}った→引っ張る：02402_hipparu⟧。
examples.english: She led the team with her unlimited versatility.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆使|くし}→駆使：14682_kushi⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{斬新|ざんしん}→斬新：09069_zanshin⟧な⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}り{上|あ}げた→作り上げる：11569_tsukuriageru⟧。
examples.english: That director made full use of his extensive knowledge in every possible way to create an innovative film.

notes:
USAGE:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧). Can be used as a na-adjective ({縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}な⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧) or as an adverb with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ ({縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧). Often used in sports commentary and writing to describe dynamic, unrestricted movement or activity.

ETYMOLOGY:
{縦|じゅう} (vertical) + {横|おう} (horizontal) + ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + {尽|じん} (limit). Literally "vertically and horizontally without limit."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧: to run freely all over
- {縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧: unlimited/all-around activity
- {縦横無尽|じゅうおうむじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆使|くし}→駆使：14682_kushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make full use in every way
